name: Workflow Use
notes: Scope is adjacent because the main path records and replays deterministic browser workflows (described as RPA 2.0); agent involvement is limited to generating a workflow from one Browser Use run and to fallback or self-healing steps, which the README marks as early and still being improved. The tree contains a Chrome recording extension, a Python workflow package (recorder, builder, healing, MCP, storage), a FastAPI backend and a web UI. The README advises against production use. The LICENSE file is the GNU AGPL v3 text with the Free Software Foundation copyright line replaced by a Browser Use Inc. notice. GitHub reports AGPL-3.0, but the catalog's verbatim-header rule leaves the code license unrecorded.
summary: Turns a recorded browser session or a Browser Use agent run into a parameterized workflow file that replays deterministically with Playwright, falling back to an LLM agent when a step fails.
